source_of_truth: The submission form in the CrazyGames developer portal states the current limits next to every field. The numbers below come from the portal's own game-covers documentation; when the form disagrees, the form wins and this file is updated in the same commit.
confirmed_by_docs: all three covers are mandatory and must share one visual style
covers carry no border, no text other than the title, and no store or social icons
a cover is not a screenshot of the game
the preview video is required in landscape AND portrait, 1080p, 15-20 seconds, no audio, at most 50 MB
the preview video opens on the static cover frame and contains no black screens, letterbox bars, cursor or promotional text
the game itself must ship English
the initial download stays under 50 MB, and under 20 MB to pass the Basic Launch benchmark
load time to first interaction stays under 10 seconds

1080p, no audio track. Mandatory alongside the landscape clip.

texts.note: The form states the cap and requires the same string the game itself shows. Must not be confusable with another game's name or iconography.
The portal publishes no character limit; these are the studio's working bounds.

undocumented: accepted image file formats and per-image byte caps
screenshot count and sizes: the portal asks for covers and a preview video only
the character limits of the listing texts other than the name, and the list of supported store languages
confirmed_by_form: the game name is capped at 35 characters and must match the title inside the game
the build is uploaded as a FOLDER, not an archive: the upload control is a directory input and the form asks only that index.html sit at its root
engine list: Externally hosted (iframe), HTML5, Unity 6, Unity 2022, Godot, Defold, GameMaker, GDevelop, Cocos, PlayCanvas; an Emscripten/wasm build files as HTML5

the progress-save question is mandatory and offers a fourth answer the docs bury: "Yes, using LocalStorage (refer to Automatic Progress Save)", which the portal syncs to the account for a player who logs in
Automatic Progress Save is offered only to hosted engines; the form says it does not work for iframe games, which must use the SDK data module
"Mobile orientation" (BOTH by default) appears only once "The game supports mobile devices" is checked
a first submission is locked to the Basic flow: the Full control is a tooltip explaining global release, not a selectable option
the steps are Upload, QA, Details, Submit; covers, videos and listing texts live in Details and are unreachable until a build is uploaded
